integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library checker included; no outside code or independent validation used.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite-dimensional unital split basic algebras over finite fields; abstract unit-group isomorphism or invariant preservation of stabilizer structure is not claimed. Infinite proof given, small-field checks are corroboration. Possible unrecognized stronger classical antecedent remains a literature risk.
title: Full-unit conjugacy spectra of commuting idempotents in split basic algebras
